Bringing Innovation On-Stage_

A proposal to reboot the CSED Department's flagship hackathon at Thapar Institute. This page is a portfolio of what the last edition shipped — the problem statements, the prizes, the sponsors and the projects — and the case for building BIOS 2.0 on top of it.
